summary: Ethiopia does not permit dual citizenship. However, the government created an 'Origin ID Card' (also called the Ethiopian Diaspora Card) in 2019 that gives diaspora Ethiopians residency and investment rights without citizenship.

citizenship.dualCitizenshipNote: Ethiopia's Nationality Proclamation (No. 378/2003) generally prohibits dual citizenship. Ethiopians who voluntarily acquire foreign citizenship automatically lose their Ethiopian citizenship.

diasporaProgram.name: Ethiopian Origin ID Card (Diaspora Card)
diasporaProgram.statusNote: Active since 2019. The Ethiopian Origin ID Card (sometimes called the Ethiopian Diaspora ID or Origin Card) gives holders of foreign passports who are of Ethiopian origin the right to reside, work, invest, own property, and access services in Ethiopia without needing a residency visa.
diasporaProgram.eligibility: Persons of Ethiopian origin who hold foreign citizenship. Requires proof of Ethiopian birth or Ethiopian parentage. The program is targeted at the diaspora estimated at 3+ million people.
diasporaProgram.applicationFeeNote: Contact Ethiopian Embassy for current fees. Fees have changed since the program's launch.
keyDocuments: Ethiopian birth certificate or parents' Ethiopian documents
processSteps: Contact Ethiopian Embassy in your country
Submit Origin ID application with proof of Ethiopian origin
Card grants residency, work, investment, and property rights in Ethiopia
diasporaProgram.verificationNote: Legal framework verified against Ethiopian Citizenship Proclamation No. 378/2003. Status refreshed November 2026: no amendments enacted in 2025-2026; dual citizenship reform has been discussed but not legislated. IMPORTANT URL UPDATE: immigration.gov.et may be outdated or inactive; the correct current agency is INVEA (Immigration, Nationality, and Vital Events Agency) at invea.gov.et. INVEA acknowledged processing backlogs in 2025, attributing them to staff shortages, high application volumes, and digitization efforts; estimated improvements by mid-2026 (unconfirmed). Processing times range from 6 months to over a year. Applying directly in Addis Ababa is reportedly faster than via embassies. Origin Card fee approximately $200 USD as of early 2026.

keyFacts: Dual citizenship NOT permitted, Ethiopians lose citizenship upon naturalizing abroad
Ethiopian Origin ID Card (Diaspora Card) is the alternative pathway
Origin Card gives residency, work rights, investment rights, and property rights
Ethiopian birr was devalued 30% overnight in 2024 under IMF program
Addis Ababa is a major hub for pan-African institutions and business
whyItMatters: Ethiopia's approach is pragmatic: no citizenship, but the Origin ID Card gives diaspora Ethiopians almost all the practical rights of residency. For the 3+ million diaspora who want to return and invest, the Origin Card is the clearest legal pathway. The citizenship restriction is real but workable.
